caption: The drawing depicts a vertical metal rod positioned centrally on a light beige, almost blank background. Near the lower end of the rod sits an inverted brownish cone resembling a funnel, with shading to indicate its three-dimensional form and metal texture. About two-thirds up the rod, a small, rust-colored metal box with a hinged lid is suspended to the left. Partially open, the box reveals an object inside, possibly a metal wedge or tool, rendered in grayish-black tones. Attached to the rod, to the right of the box, is a brown cobbler's shoe last, fixated by a metal clamp mechanism. The overall color palette consists of browns, rust tones, grays, and muted metallic shades, all set against the neutral background. The composition is vertical, with each item carefully spaced along the central rod.
title: Betty Lamp
